## Highlights

- Xero and Seazona are set up on Flow's own screens, with credentials sealed in Postgres. ([#64](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/64))
- Connecting Xero imports its invoice history. ([#61](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/61))

## Changes

- Import Xero history on connect, and carry earlier order to invoice links over at start. ([#61](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/61))
- Set up Xero and Seazona in Flow, with credentials sealed in Postgres. ([#64](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/64))
